attributes: Invented by Louis Braille from France (blinded by tool accident at age 3)
Embossed dots on thick paper read by finger touch
Standard Braille is based on 6 DOTS arranged in 2x3 matrix cells
Can now be typed on computerized braille embossers

historical_figures_and_travelers.key_contributions: Created the 6-dot embossed tactile Braille writing code
